name: hexagon-vscode
description: Language support for the Hexagon language: highlighting, diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, and find-references.

hexagon.languageServer.enabled.description: Run the Hexagon language server. Turn this off to keep syntax highlighting alone.

hexagon.languageServer.path.description: Absolute path to a hexagon-language-server build to run instead of the one bundled with this extension. Intended for developing the server itself.

hexagon.languageServer.trustedStandardLi.description: Absolute project roots explicitly authorized to compile their sources as registered Hex standard-library members. Intended only for developing the standard library.

hexagon.inlayHints.types.markdownDescription: Show the types inference gives the places a type could be written: a parameter, a function's result, a `let` with no written type. Shown only: a hint is never written into the file.

hexagon.inlayHints.colours.markdownDescription: Show a function's colour in words, such as "impure; may fail", at the end of its header's line. A header has no place to write it.

hexagon.inlayHints.regexGroups.markdownDescription: Show each capturing group's number, the one `Regex.group` reads it by, at its `(` in a pattern handed to `Regex.compile` as a literal.

hexagon.format.maximumLineLength.markdownDescription: The longest a line of code may be before Format Document and Format Selection break it, in characters (Unicode code points). Leave it empty for Unlimited, under which no line is ever broken. A string or a comment is never broken, and a trailing comment does not count.

hexagon.format.collapseExtraSpaces.markdownDescription: Make every gap where Hexagon's layout calls for one space exactly one space when formatting. Off, a wider gap the author wrote is kept, so code aligned in columns keeps its alignment.

hexagon.format.leaveTrailingCommasAsWrit.markdownDescription: Add no trailing commas when formatting. Off, Format Document and Format Selection add a comma after the last item of every list whose closing bracket begins its line. Either way, a comma already written is kept.

hexagon.trace.server.description: Log the traffic between this extension and the Hexagon language server.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:extension
